# GSAP 3.15.1 (D344)

Files copied unchanged from the npm package `gsap@3.15.1` (`dist/*.min.js`), with their copyright and license notices
intact, as the license asks. GSAP is free for any website, commercial use included (Standard "No Charge" GSAP
License, https://gsap.com/standard-license); the only uses it excludes are visual no-code animation builders that
compete with Webflow, which Slabwise is not. `prototype/v7/build.py` inlines them in the page before Slabby and the app.

To update: `npm pack gsap@<version>`, copy the same `dist/*.min.js` files here, change the version above and in D344.
